title: feat(research): price escape from refined P104 intervals
body:
## Summary

Extend PR #2136's survivor separator to a quantitative obstruction for **added paid rank**, while allowing arbitrary nested subdivision of all retained P104 transport obligations.

```text
56 independent R-side source arrays
8 original entering array positions + at most B added positions
B >= 48
retained no-credit mass >= 60,840 / 60,736 = 585/584 > 1
```

Only `research/p104-refinement-rank-budget/` is added. It contains the scoped proof, source-bound verifier, complete receipt, nine tests and an opt-in replay hook. The scientific base is canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. [Canonical claim and status](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2144).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR #2136 proves the unaugmented 56-array bound but does not price escape. PR #2127's 96-transport result retains unsplit occurrences.
- **After:** the written transcript argument gives `B >= 48` with arbitrary nested refinements, added transports and source-independent storage. The exact no-progress-credit screen from PR #2082 then fails at zero saving. A changed coverage proof must credit more than `104/9` ranks per call even at the minimum added cost.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes normally and with `-O`; all five semantic rejection controls and nine CLI/export tests pass. The nine tests also pass under `-O`. Separately, all 65 repository research workflow tests pass. A separate CPython 3.13.5 optimized replay agrees. Environment: Linux x86_64, standard library only.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-refinement-rank-budget
python3.12 -I -O -X dev -W error -B research/p104-refinement-rank-budget/test_verify.py
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

The new contribution is the added-rank implication and budget decision, not a new separator. Credit Tairitsu-Aya/PR #2136, Ross Richardson/PR #2127, David Arias/PR #2082 and the earlier cuts; Rohan Arun/PR #1972, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR #1991 and their geometry/native/coverage predecessors remain credited in the README. Exact heads and source hashes are recorded.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

This is an author-checked scoped proof and finite premise check, not a supplier or exponent improvement. It retains original obligations without removal, fusion or branching. Its moment conclusion assumes the explicit no-progress-credit coverage contract. Changed producers, replacement paths and justified coverage credit remain open; Discussion #2131 and PR #2139 are not excluded.

Native phases, the original scalar endpoint, chronological hosting, precision/tape, all-size admission and the full selected cold replay were not rerun. The transcript proof is not formal-kernel verified or independently human-reviewed. The selected record and frozen evidence are unchanged. Live overlap was refreshed before submission; exact coverage and its limits are in `TASK.json`.
